The Information Technology Administration ensures that the Divisions’ mission, vision, and values are upheld. Directs all

The Operations Departments are the central hub for all technological functions. These departments maintain and support
over 120 applications, manage the network infrastructure, manage a world-class data center, implement, and maintain the
City’s security policies and procedures, plan and oversee projects, conduct training, provide technical support for software
